items.reason: The referer interpolation and JavaScript breakout claim matches #25. Its additional full-URL targetOrigin claim also repeats rejected issue #26.
Same claim that request.referer lacks JavaScript escaping in the embed layout, allowing quote-breakout XSS.
Same claim that using the full referer URL as postMessage targetOrigin drops resize messages and breaks iframe resizing.
Same claim that the controller spec fails because it expects synchronous TopicRetriever construction while the action only enqueues a job.
